title: Recording, editing: Beware My Love by Wings | 1976
content:
Studio Two, Abbey Road Studios, London
Producer: Paul McCartney
Engineer: Peter Henderson

Wings re-recorded the Wings At The Speed Of Sound song ‘Beware My Love’ on 26 January 1976.

They had recorded an early version of the song on 28 August 1975, reworked it on 17 October, recorded 14 rehearsal takes on 22 January, and taped 21 new takes the following day.

On this day they recorded 17 new takes. Take 53 was marked ‘good’, but Paul McCartney decided instead to revisit the 23 January recordings. An edit containing the beginning and end of take 19 and the middle of take 20 was then made, onto which lead and backing vocals were overdubbed.
